title: AIR Roots Index
description: Index of agent root configurations. A root is a self-contained agent workspace — a git repository (or subdirectory within one) that contains everything an agent needs to operate in a specific domain.

propertyNames.description: Root identifier key. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

Root.description: An agent root — a self-contained workspace for a specific domain.

description.description: What this agent root is for. Should be clear to anyone in the organization.

url.description: Git repository URL for this root.

default_branch.description: Default branch to use when cloning (defaults to 'main').

subdirectory.description: Path within the repository to the root directory (for monorepo setups).

default_in_roots.description: Names of other roots for which this root acts as a default subagent. Use the literal "*" to make it a subagent of every resolved root (the root never becomes a subagent of itself). The default CLI behavior merges subagent roots' skills and MCP servers into the parent session and appends subagent metadata to the system prompt; orchestrators that manage subagent composition externally can opt out with --no-subagent-merge. This inverts the legacy default_subagent_roots array: membership is now declared on the subagent root rather than on the parent.

default_runtime.description: Agent runtime to use for sessions and subagents spawned under this root. When omitted, resolves to the default runtime 'claude_code'. The listed values are common runtimes, but this is an open string field — any runtime identifier a downstream consumer recognizes is accepted, so new agents do not require a schema change.

user_invocable.description: Whether this root can be directly invoked by users to start a session.
